Correct the ts field. Additionally, tighten two areas on rerun: (1) the objections[0] entry treats routine calendar-juggling as a 3-attempt objection-handling sequence — reclassify as scheduling negotiation rather than formal objection to avoid inflating rep persistence credit; (2) the protocols.spouse_decision reference at 01:22 misapplies a schema section meant for decision-maker deferral language to a simple third-party schedule mention — reframe as an unresolved co-owner identity note not mapped to that specific protocol trigger. Both are minor/moderate; the core trajectory read, outcome dispute, and handoff brief are otherwise well-grounded and should be preserved as-is.
